correctness.rationale: Full six-state linearization gives characteristic (lambda²+c lambda+B+Z)[(lambda²+h lambda+k)²-Z(lambda²+h lambda+k)+Z²]. Strictly positive c,B,h,k and the complex cube-root sensing eigenvalues force exactly one nonzero-frequency crossing at k=Z/2+3Z²/(4h²); explicit positive rightward eigenvalue derivative certifies every sign region and no further crossings. Reciprocal channel gives the stationary threshold 2k; strict comparison follows algebraically. Implicit differentiation yields monotonicity in D and leading asymptotic 12 D². Two-state row-stochastic matrices have real eigenvalues, precluding Hopf at zero mobility for <=2 patches. Positive feasible logistic witness and independent symbolic six-state Jacobian verification establish normalization. Unproved nonlinear periodic orbit claims are excluded.

originality.rationale: Exact directed-information linear onset, strict comparison with reciprocal sensing, strictly increasing symmetric-mobility threshold, and the no-mobility minimum of three patches were not found as statements or implications in the inspected source claims. value.rationale: The information-flow architecture can be changed independently of symmetric disease movement and fixed endemic equilibrium. Exact directed-versus-reciprocal spectral thresholds reveal a nonempty regime of oscillatory epidemic instability caused only by report direction with no explicit perception lag, while the reciprocal design is stable. A three-site sharp minimum, stabilization with population mobility and explicit admissible parameter construction give natural mechanisms and concrete system-design interpretation, beyond a trivial numerical observation or relabeling of directed mobility instability.
